skill.name: wp-migrate
skill.description: Guides WordPress migrations, archive imports, rollback, testing, and maintenance workflows with wp-migrate.sh across local and SSH destinations.
skill.summary: Plan, test, run, and troubleshoot WordPress migrations with wp-migrate.sh.
skill.author: BWBama85

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, repository links, placeholders, and fixed development commands. Confirmed risks include predictable shared temporary paths, a system-wide binary rename during testing, and installation of an unverified remote WP-CLI executable. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: WP-CLI is downloaded from a moving branch and installed globally without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Use a pinned WP-CLI release, verify its published checksum or signature, and only then install it through a controlled package or deployment process.

remediation.issue: Temporary SSH and archive paths use predictable names under shared /tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Create private directories with mktemp -d, enforce mode 0700, reject symlinks, and remove directories with a trap after use.

remediation.issue: A test renames the system-wide WP-CLI executable with sudo.
remediation.suggestion: Test missing dependencies in a container or with an isolated PATH and mock executable instead of changing /usr/local/bin.

content.value_statement: WordPress migrations can damage data, paths, or URLs when steps are missed. This skill guides preview, backup, migration, rollback, and troubleshooting workflows with wp-migrate.sh.
actual_capabilities: Plans push migrations between WordPress servers over SSH.
Guides imports from Duplicator, Jetpack Backup, and Solid Backups archives.
Explains dry runs, confirmations, verbose logs, trace output, and quiet automation.
Supports URL replacement, table prefix alignment, and destination plugin preservation.
Provides backup discovery, rollback planning, and recovery checks.
Guides project builds, ShellCheck validation, tests, pull requests, and releases.
limitations: Requires wp-migrate.sh, WP-CLI, SSH access, and relevant archive utilities.
Does not provide hosting credentials, database secrets, or server permissions.
Migration and rollback commands can overwrite databases and wp-content.
Archive guidance is limited to Duplicator, Jetpack Backup, and Solid Backups formats.

use_cases.title: Move a WordPress site
use_cases.description: Preview and run a controlled migration between source and destination servers.

use_cases.title: Automate repeatable deployments
use_cases.description: Prepare non-interactive migration workflows with logs, backups, and rollback controls.

use_cases.title: Maintain wp-migrate.sh
use_cases.description: Build, test, document, and release changes using the project workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a push migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me preview a WordPress migration from this site to [destination host] at [destination root]. Check prerequisites and use dry-run mode.

prompt_templates.title: Import a backup archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an import from [archive path]. Identify the backup format, required space, destination backups, URL changes, and rollback steps before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a failed migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this migration failure: [error and logs]. Separate source, SSH, archive, database, and filesystem causes. Recommend verification steps before retrying.

prompt_templates.title: Design controlled automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a non-interactive wp-migrate.sh workflow for [environment]. Include secret handling, preflight checks, backups, logging, failure recovery, and post-migration validation.

output_examples.input: Preview a push migration to a staging server before changing any data.
output: Prerequisites: confirm SSH access, destination path, WP-CLI availability, and free disk space.
Preview: run dry-run with verbose output and review source and destination URLs.
Safety gate: verify backups and require explicit approval before the real migration.

output_examples.input: Import a Jetpack Backup archive and preserve destination-only plugins.
output: Archive plan: validate the Jetpack structure and confirm sufficient extraction space.
Migration plan: back up the destination, preserve destination plugins, and align URLs.
Recovery plan: record database and wp-content backups before import.

output_examples.input: Investigate a database import failure after archive extraction.
output: Check the detected SQL files, database connectivity, packet limits, and table prefix.
Review verbose logs without exposing credentials.
Restore the destination backup before retrying a corrected import.

best_practices: Start every migration with dry-run and review the complete preview.
Verify database and wp-content backups before any destructive operation.
Test rollback and post-migration checks in a safe environment.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass confirmation without independent automation safeguards.
Do not paste credentials or private key contents into prompts or logs.
Do not run rollback or cleanup commands from an unverified working directory.

faq.question: Which migration modes are supported?
faq.answer: Push mode transfers a site over SSH. Archive mode imports supported WordPress backup archives locally.

faq.question: Which archive formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers Duplicator, Jetpack Backup, and Solid Backups archives.

faq.question: Can I preview changes first?
faq.answer: Yes. Use dry-run with verbose output and review the migration summary before approval.

faq.question: Does the skill store my credentials?
faq.answer: No. You must provide and protect SSH, hosting, and database credentials outside the skill.

faq.question: Can it automate migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents non-interactive options, but your pipeline must provide secret handling, backups, validation, and failure controls.

faq.question: Can it recover a failed migration?
faq.answer: It provides rollback and manual recovery guidance when valid destination backups are available.
